messages:
Maria (sec-eng): @channel quick heads up — in the last ~45m we've seen a pattern where SAML 'groups' claim is getting truncated on a subset of assertions. JIT provisioning is falling back to the 'organization:admin' role for those users. Looks correlated with yesterday's RBAC refactor + the idp delimiter change. Need triage and mitigation ASAP.

Sam (eng-infra): Do we have an example assertion + logs?

Maria (sec-eng): Pasting a sanitized assertion from auth-service logs (notice groups truncated):

```json
{
  "subject": "alice@example.com",
  "attributes": {
    "email": "alice@example.com",
    "groups": "engineering,infra,platform,security,devops,product,legal,compliance,finance-TEAM-EXTRA-TRUNC..."
  },
  "signature_valid": true
}
```

Maria (sec-eng): Mapping rules: if groups contains any entry mapped -> grant scoped role; if groups missing/short -> fallback role "organization:admin" (default from the RBAC refactor).

Anika (idp-engineer): Hmm. We shipped a small change to how we join group lists (delimiter normalization) in idp-service yesterday (PR #489). Okta assertions might exceed header/body handling and end up truncated on our side. @deploy-bot shows last idp deploy around 1887654000.

deploy-bot: idp-service v2.14.7 deployed by anika at 1887654000 (sha: ab12f3)

Lee (sre-oncall): We detected ~24 sessions in last 30m that got the org-admin role. Any audit records for those JIT events?

Maria (sec-eng): Partial — auth-audit ingestion returned 500 for some events around 1887654120. So assignments were applied but ~40% of the provision events didn't make it into the audit index.

Joe (platform): The ingestion 500s line up with KMS rotation job that ran at 1887654100 (rotation of signing key id kms-key-2026-04). If audit events are signed/enveloped and signature validation failed at ingest time, the pipeline may have rejected them.

Anika (idp-engineer): Confirming: KMS rotated last night; idp-service config wasn't updated with the new key id because the helm secret was templated incorrectly in the PR. The service still accepts the assertion (signature header unchecked earlier), but our post-processing that extracts groups hits a char limit if signature blob size changes. It's a messy interaction.

Sam (eng-infra): Proposed immediate steps: 
1) Roll back idp-service delimiter/join change (force old behavior)
2) Temporarily disable JIT auto-assign to high-privilege defaults (no automatic assignment to organization:admin)
3) Requeue failed audit events for reingest after we fix KMS/config issues
4) Add alert for truncated groups > 5 occurrences in 5m and for audit-ingest 5xxs

Maria (sec-eng): I'm opening an incident now and will revoke any suspicious org-admin sessions if needed. @anika can you cut the rollback? I'll also coordinate the audit backfill.

Anika (idp-engineer): On it — starting rollback to v2.14.6 now. Will monitor assertion size + mapping behavior.

deploy-bot: rollback idp-service to v2.14.6 by anika at 1887654450 (sha: 9f8e7d)

Anika (idp-engineer): Rollback complete. Observed assertion payload lengths normalized; groups parsing appears stable in first smoke checks.

Maria (sec-eng): Thanks. I'm re-running the reingest job for the 1887654100-1887654300 window now; will post results. Also will update RBAC defaults to block auto-assigning org-admin on missing attributes.

Lee (sre-oncall): Added an alert rule and short-lived mitigation: block JIT for role mappings that would resolve to organization:admin until we have a postmortem.

Joe (platform): I'll validate KMS secret templating in helm charts and open a patch PR to ensure rotation updates the idp config in CI.

Maria (sec-eng): Good plan. Follow-ups: postmortem with timeline + root cause (RBAC default + idp delimiter change + KMS rotation ordering) and action items for audit hardening.

Anika (idp-engineer): I'll include the diff that caused group join behavior and add integration test for long group lists.

Maria (sec-eng): Appreciated. Will keep thread updated with ingest backfill status.

Lee (sre-oncall): Monitoring — will escalate if we see any spike. :eyes:
